lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Guided practice A: proportional and algebraic models

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: A data set is 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The mean is 20. What is the mean absolute deviation?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A student claims a box that is 3 by 3 by 5 units has a volume of 53 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Yes; the volume is 53 cubic units.
No; the volume is 54 cubic units, not 53.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 45 cubic units, not 53.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $4 base fee plus $2 per hour. A customer's total bill was $18. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 23 m, then descends another 3 m, then ascends 11 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 33 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $840 rate will increase by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 11 ft long, 8 ft wide, and 6 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 35, 50, 65, 80, 95. The mean is 65. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 8 by 2 by 4 units has a volume of 16 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Yes; the volume is 16 cubic units.
No; the volume is 17 cubic units, not 16.
No; the volume is 64 cubic units, not 16.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $2 base fee plus $6 per hour. A customer's total bill was $56. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.
